achievements.label: First Watt
achievements.description: Build your first power plant, of any type.

achievements.label: Renewable Pioneer
achievements.description: Build your first Solar, Wind, or Hydro plant.

achievements.label: Quarter Clean
achievements.description: Get renewables to at least 25% of your grid's total capacity.

achievements.label: Halfway There
achievements.description: Get renewables to at least 50% of your grid's total capacity.

achievements.label: Mostly Clean
achievements.description: Get renewables to at least 75% of your grid's total capacity.

achievements.label: Zero Fossil
achievements.description: Run a standing grid with no coal or gas capacity at all.

achievements.label: Learning Curve Paid Off
achievements.description: Build enough of one renewable type to drive its cost down to the 40% floor.

achievements.label: Full Portfolio
achievements.description: Have every plant type standing on your grid at the same time.

achievements.label: Phase-Out Complete
achievements.description: Build up real fossil capacity, then retire every last coal and gas plant.

achievements.label: Steady Hand
achievements.description: Go 15 rounds in a row without a single disruption event.

achievements.label: Untouched
achievements.description: Reach round 21 without ever having a plant damaged by a disruption.

achievements.label: Sustained Effort
achievements.description: Reach a sustained clean-grid score of 50 or higher, at least 10 rounds in.

achievements.label: The Transition Pays Off
achievements.description: Reach a sustained clean-grid score of 80 or higher, at least 20 rounds in.

achievements.label: Well Maintained
achievements.description: Use Maintain 5 times to keep your fleet's average age down.

achievements.label: Ahead of the Curve
achievements.description: Beat the global-average-fossil-mix emissions benchmark, 10+ rounds in.
